acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira talks with a teacher in South Carolina who is just trying to figure out what the first day of school will look like.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Two teachers find themselves thrown into a heated and ugly fight with parents right before school opens back up. Producer Miki Meek has this story from Utah.
acts.title: Masked Crusaders

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Aviva DeKornfeld talks with a high schooler about how he’s prepped for remote learning with a bunch of kids he doesn’t know.
acts.title: Screen Times at Ridgemont High

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Some schools started back in July, including many in Tennessee. David Kestenbaum talks to one teacher there who’s already gone through a month of in-person learning to see what the future might hold for other schools.
acts.title: Future Imperfect

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: A school that has prepared for every Covid scenario faces a problem they never saw coming. Stephanie Wang tells the story of one Indiana school's first day in person. Stephanie is the bureau chief of Chalkbeat Indiana.
acts.title: The Case of the Well-Prepared Elementary School

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: A week after starting classes, a Covid outbreak forces a university to send students back home. Producer Robyn Semien takes a tour of the emptying campus.
acts.title: The Leftovers
